primary.title: The Diaries of George Washington

primary.title: George Washington Papers
primary.author: George Washington
primary.rationale: A vast collection of correspondence, military papers, and public records offering comprehensive insight into his career and thoughts.

secondary.title: George Washington: A Life

secondary.title: The Papers of George Washington: Presidential Series

secondary.title: Washington: A Life
secondary.author: Douglas Southall Freeman
secondary.rationale: Though older, this multi-volume biography is considered a monumental work of scholarship and remains a key reference, often cited in later works.
